lyrics:
[Intro: drum break, horn stabs, clavinet riff]

[Verse 1: energetic male tenor, playful]
Anybody can sing when the check comes through
When the test comes back and the sky is blue
But I got a song with a different trick
It gets louder when the going gets thick

[Chorus: full band, horns, choir answers]
I sing louder on the low days (louder!)
Dance harder on the hard ones (harder!)
When the bottom drops out, that's my cue
I got a song that the dark can't use
Turn it up when it all goes wrong
Louder on the low days

[Verse 2: tenor, bass and drums pushing]
Two men in a jail cell, midnight, beat
Chains on their ankles, stocks on their feet
They started singing like the doors were wide
And the ground shook loose and the locks all died

[Pre-Chorus: horns climbing]
Same song, same reason, same King
The one who walked out of a grave in spring

[Chorus: full band, horns, choir answers]
I sing louder on the low days (louder!)
Dance harder on the hard ones (harder!)
When the bottom drops out, that's my cue
I got a song that the dark can't use
Turn it up when it all goes wrong
Louder on the low days

[Breakdown: drums and claps, call and response]
Who's it for? (Jesus!)
Who rolled the stone? (Jesus!)
Who's still good on a bad day? (Jesus!)
Then what do we do? (Louder!)

[Final Chorus: key up, horns screaming, choir full]
I sing louder on the low days (louder!)
Dance harder on the hard ones (harder!)
When the bottom drops out, that's my cue
I got a song that the dark can't use
Turn it up when it all goes wrong
Louder on the low days

[Outro: horn riff, choir laughing, one last hit]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 126 BPM, 4/4, E major, lifting to F# major for the final chorus. Fast, funky and bouncing.

VOICE: Male tenor, bright and elastic, with gospel runs and a preacher's sense of timing. A mixed choir shouts the answers and sings the choruses in full harmony. The breakdown is pure call and response.

INSTRUMENTS: A tight live drum kit with a loud snare, slap-and-pop electric bass, clavinet, a three-piece horn section (trumpet, tenor saxophone, trombone), rhythm guitar playing muted funk chords, Hammond organ, tambourine and handclaps.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, drum break and horns. 0:10 Verse 1. 0:30 Chorus 1. 0:58 Verse 2, the jail. 1:18 Pre-chorus. 1:26 Chorus 2. 1:54 Breakdown, call and response. 2:16 Final chorus, key up. 2:46 Outro, horn riff and a last hit at 3:10.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 1970s funk played by a modern gospel band: dry, punchy, horns bright, choir wide and close.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The four-part call and response at 1:54, ending in the crowd's 'Louder!'.

THE REVEAL: Verse 1 and the first chorus are any singer's defiance. Verse 2 at 0:58 is Paul and Silas in Acts 16, the pre-chorus names the risen King, and the breakdown answers every question with one name.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Cocky, tested, defiant, jubilant.
